hypothesis: The governed system can operate one $250,000 paper portfolio for six weeks with complete point-in-time lineage, fail-closed readiness, singular implementation, reconciliation, and after-cost benchmark reconstruction; results are descriptive evidence for human review, not proof of long-term outperformance.
benchmark_definition: 80% VTI and 20% SGOV, valued from the same point-in-time quote authority, with recorded spread/slippage costs and no look-ahead reconstitution.
observation_schedule: One canonical post-reconciliation UTC observation per completed operating date; weekends and valid no-action days remain explicit.
change_control: Any code, provider, universe, cost, benchmark, schedule, metric, threshold, or configuration change terminates this registration. Preserve its observations and register a new version; never splice or silently restart.
